clinical_caveat: SutureBot2 is a proof-of-concept robotic, ex-vivo wound-closure dataset. Scores shown here are either expert-defined (future work) or a derived geometric-consistency proxy; they are NOT a validated clinical outcome and do NOT rate a human dermatologist's performance.

oracle.note: Ground-truth boxes by definition achieve perfect localization; these values define the upper reference, not a trained detector.

detection.note: ultralytics not used; predicted-box scoring is illustrative until a detector is trained.

notes: Expert-score setting is a skipped placeholder because SutureBot2 has no expert 1-5 ratings. All reported scores are the geometric-consistency proxy. Human inter-rater agreement is the ceiling.
